clips.title: Rapid 3-Kill Streak
clips.description: The player secures three consecutive eliminations in quick succession using a light machine gun. The first kill occurs at 00:01, followed by a second at 00:11 and a third at 00:14, resulting in a '3rd Kill' notification on screen.
clips.reason: This segment clearly demonstrates a killstreak with three distinct eliminations in a short timeframe, directly matching the user's objective.
